sections.heading: Marsanes
sections.body: *Translated by Samuel Zinner; edited by Mark Mattison (Other Gospels Nag Hammadi Initiative)*

sections.heading: 1. The Father Draws Near
sections.body:
**1.** [... of matter ...] and a [power].

**2.** They discovered him with a pure heart; they are untroubled by harms.

**3.** Those who have accepted you will be granted an excellent reward for their perseverance, and [they will] bear with harms.

**4.** May not one of us, [however], be troubled and assume [in] his heart that the supreme Father [is remote], because he gazes on the All and cares for all of them,

**5.** and [he] has disclosed to them his [command], because [they] are the ones who speak [...].

**6.** [... the matters I spoke] at the first.

sections.heading: 2. The Thirteen Seals
sections.body:
**1.** Regarding the thirteenth seal, however, I have established it together with the apex of knowledge and with the certitude of repose.

**2.** The first, [and the] second, and the [third] pertain to the realms of the world and of matter.

**3.** I have [told] you of these, so that you would [watch over] your bodies,

**4.** and a sensorial [power] will [hide] those who will dwell in repose, and they will be preserved [from the] desires and the dividing [of the] union.

**5.** The fourth [and the] fifth over it [pertains to those that] you have come to understand [are divine.]

**6.** [The fourth pertains to what] exists over the [somatic type] and nature that [is separated in] three.

**7.** By these [two] you [were told] of [these and of the realm of] three [dimensions].

**8.** You [were told that it] is non-somatic [...].

**9.** [...] and thereafter [...] inside [...] all [...] which [...] and the things inside them.

**10.** The [fifth pertains to the] repentance [of] those inside [it], and of those who abide in that place.

**11.** The sixth pertains to those who are self-generated, to the non-somatic being existing as an individual together with those who [in] understanding and immovability dwell in the truth of the All.

**12.** The [seventh] pertains to the self-generated power, the third [Perfect Mind, the second one who prolonged itself into] [the] fourth for rescue [by means of] Sophia.

**13.** The eighth pertains to the [masculine] mind [that] manifested itself [in the beginning], and to the [non-somatic] being, and to the [intelligible] world.

**14.** The ninth [pertains to the name] of the power [that] manifested itself [in the beginning].

**15.** The tenth [pertains to Barbelo, the male] virgin, namely, the Aeon.

**16.** [The eleventh] and [the twelfth] tell of the Invisible One possessing three powers, and of the Spirit beyond being, who is of the Primal Ungenerated One.

**17.** The thirteenth tells of [the Unknown] Silent One, the source of the One who cannot be discerned, because I am the one who has [studied] what exists in reality.

**18.** Through discernment [I understood] that they [pre-]exist, [either] as individuals or [as a totality], [in the] entire place that is eternal, specifically: all of those who have come to exist, either with being or beyond being; those who are unbegotten; and the divine aeons, together with the angels and the guileless souls, and the living [garments], being the images of the unitary ones.

**19.** Moreover, [after this they] were combined with [those who had been separate from] them.

**20.** Nevertheless, [even] all of [sensorial] being is similar to the [intelligible being] and what is beyond being.

**21.** [I have understood] the entirety of the indestructability [of the former], as well as the deathlessness of the latter.

sections.heading: 3. The Self-Generated One
sections.body:
**1.** I have discerned and have achieved the border between the partial, perceptible sensorial world and all of the realm of the non-somatic essence,

**2.** and by discernment the intelligible world understood that the perceptible sensorial world [deserves] to be conserved fully, in all particulars, [because] I have not stopped telling [of] the Self-Generated One, [so that] in turn, [no one] would be [ignorant] of the entirety of the place.

**3.** He descended, and he descended again from the Unbegotten One who is beyond being, who is the Spirit.

**4.** The one who exists before all of them is prolonged [to the] self-generated [Gods].

**5.** The one who has [being] searches [the All], and (indeed) is [the All, even] resembling [the All],

**6.** and they [were] separated from [the singular one], [so that] I underwent numerous things.

**7.** It became clear that he had rescued a throng.

sections.heading: 4. The Nature of Silence
sections.body:
**1.** Beyond all of these things, however, I search for the beginningless kingdom of the Triple-Powered One.

**2.** From where has he appeared and worked to fill the entirety of the place with his power?

**3.** How did the ungenerated ones come to exist without being generated?

**4.** What are the distinctions between the [aeons, and] how many ungenerated ones [exist]?

**5.** In what specific way [are they dissimilar] to one another?

**6.** When I had investigated these matters, I realized that he acts in Silence.

**7.** He exists before those who exist in reality, who are of the realm of being.

**8.** He is a pre-existent Other who is of the one that is active inside the Silent One,

**9.** and the silence of [the one who follows] him will be active, because [as long as] the latter [remains active], the former [will also remain active].

**10.** The [silence that is of the Un]begotten One is in the midst of [the aeons,]

**11.** [and from] the beginning he has not had [being], but the action of (the Unbegotten One) ‹is› (that of) the Triple-Powered One.

**12.** The Unbegotten One existed before the Aeon, because he is beyond [being].

sections.heading: 5. The Triple-Powered One
sections.body:
**1.** Now, regarding the apex of the silence of the Silent One, the apex of the activity of the Triple-Powered One can see it, and He Who Is, who is silent, [who] surpasses [beyond being], made manifest [the Triple-Powered, the Primal] Perfect One.

**2.** [When he showed himself] to the powers, they rejoiced.

**3.** Those who dwell inside me were completed together with all of the rest,

**4.** and they each individually all blessed the Triple-Powered One, the Primal-Perfect One, [blessing] him in purity.

**5.** [In every] place they praised the Lord [who exists] before the All, [the] Triple-Powered One.

**6.** [It was not the case that] their praises [could be heard], but [my role was to persist investigating] how they could have been silent.

**7.** I studied a power that I esteemed as honorable.

sections.heading: 6. Barbelo
sections.body:
**1.** When the third power of the Triple-Powered One had studied him, it told me: “Remain silent, so that you might not understand and run away and approach me,

**2.** but understand that this One remained [silent], and pay attention to comprehending,

**3.** because [the power still] continues to [lead] me into [the Aeon, that] is, Barbelo, the male [virgin].”

**4.** Separating herself from the male was what caused the virgin to become male.

**5.** Understanding stood outside of himself, as though it were of him,

**6.** and she who exists ‹is› she who searched.

**7.** She is positioned exactly where the Triple-Powered One is positioned.

**8.** She retreated from [these] two [powers], because she exists [outside of] the Great One, [beholding what] is over [her, the] silent [perfect one, who received] this [commandment] to remain silent.

**9.** His understanding, and his existence, and his action comprise those things the power of the Triple-Powered One articulated:

**10.** “All of us have retreated into ourselves.

**11.** We have [grown] silent, and when we [also] came to understand [that he is] the Triple-Powered One, [we] prostrated. We [extolled and] blessed him.

**12.** [He bestowed] on us [a mighty revelation].”

sections.heading: 7. Marsanes Ascends
sections.body:
**1.** The unseen [Spirit once more] hurried to his place.

**2.** The entirety of the place was revealed; the entirety of the place opened up ‹until› he attained to the region above.

**3.** He went forth once more to illumine the entirety of the place, and the entirety of the place was illumined.

**4.** [I] was also granted the third portion of [the Spirit] of the power of the Triple-[Powered One].

**5.** Blessed be [the Aeon] which spoke: “O [you who inhabit these] places!

**6.** It is incumbent [on you to study] those who are exalted over these, and to speak them to the powers, because you will [excel over] the chosen [in the last] days.

**7.** The unseen Spirit climbs upward, and you [yourselves] ascend [upward] together with him, because you have the large [shining] crown,

**8.** but on that day, you will see [while you rush to] ascend above [together with him],

**9.** and [also] the perceptible sensorial [entities that are] visible [to you ...] and they [...].”

sections.heading: 11. Letter Mysticism
sections.body:
**1.** The soul, however, also [possesses] its arrangement, even though it is different.

**2.** [Its] form is that [in] which the arrangement of the only-begotten soul dwells.

**3.** Its arrangement is [the second] spherical portion, EĒIOU, while the first moves around [it], the self-begotten soul, AEĒIOUŌ.

**4.** [The] second arrangement, EĒIOU, originates from those [that possess] two sounds.

**5.** The first, positioned after them, is [the upsilon], and [the iota accompanies it, and you know these] in [the brilliance] of the light.

**6.** [Restrain] yourselves, accept the indestructible seed, bear fruit, and cling not to your possessions.

**7.** Understand, however, that the long vowels subsist with the vowels and the diphthongs next to them, but the [short] are incomplete, like the [additional sounds that] come to be through them, and those that [are drawn] are the intermediate ones.

**8.** Among the [consonants], the [semi]vowels excel over the voiceless ones, and the doubles excel over the unchanging semivowels, and the aspirates are superior to the inaspirates ‹of› the voiceless consonants.

**9.** Regarding the intermediate ones, their combinations are varied.

**10.** They are ignorant [concerning] the beneficial combinations, and they are combined together with the inferior ones of the [middle.]

**11.** [As] is the case for the taxonomy of the [gods] and the angels, it is [not the case that] the consonants are combined with one another arbitrarily, but only that they are combined in order to produce a beneficial effect.

**12.** It was not owing to happenstance that their intention became apparent.

**13.** Do not [continue sinning], and do not risk involving yourself in sin.

sections.heading: 12. Letters of the Soul
sections.body:
**1.** Now [I] address you [concerning the three arrangements of the form] of the soul.

**2.** [The] third [arrangement of the soul] is [a sphere, and] something spherical moves around it.

**3.** The simple vowels are:

‹AAA›, EEE, ‹ĒĒĒ›, III, OO, UUU, ŌŌŌ.

**4.** Originating from them follow the diphthongs:

AI, AU, [E]I, EU, ĒU, OU, OI, ĒI, [U]I, ŌI,

AU EI, EU ĒU, OI OU,

[GG]G, GGG, GGG,

AI AU, [EI EU],

ĒU, OI, OU, ŌU, GGG, [GGG],

AUEIEU, OIOU, ĒU,
thrice for a male soul.

**5.** The third arrangement is spherical.

**6.** The second arrangement, because it moves around it, possesses two sounds.

**7.** The third arrangement, of the male soul, comprises the simple vowels:

AAA, EEE, ĒĒĒ, III, OOO, UUU, ŌŌŌ, ŌŌŌ, ŌŌŌ,

**8.** and this arrangement is different [from] the first one, but [they are similar to] one another, [and they easily] produce various [sounds] of [this kind, AEĒ]OŌ, and from these the diphthongs are formed.

sections.heading: 13. Letters of the Angels
sections.body:
**1.** It is the same with the fourth and the fifth, concerning which the entire matter was not permitted to become manifest, but only the (most) apparent aspects.

**2.** You were instructed concerning them, so that you could study them that they also could search and discover [what] all of them are, either by themselves alone or by one another, or (that you could) search for the manifestation of [limits] established from the beginning, either alluding to themselves alone [or] alluding to one another.

**3.** Exactly as [the letters] are compresent with each other [in] speech, either individually or according to resemblance, [they are] prefixed, or [they] are suffixed.

**4.** Their [portion] is either derived and similar, through [the long] vowels or [through] those with [value of dual time, or] through [the short vowels], being short [...].

**5.** [...] or the oxytones, or the medial tones, or the barytones,

**6.** and in some instances consonants are compresent with the vowels, and according to portion they are attached at the beginning and attached at the end.

**7.** They form a taxonomy [for] the angels, and in some instances the consonants exist individually and variously, ‹they› being prefixed and suffixed to the concealed gods.

**8.** With beat and pitch, and pause and attack, [they] invoke the semivowels, all of them submitting with one [accord],

**9.** because only the [invariant consonants] ‹and› the double consonants are compresent with the semivowels, but the aspirates, [inaspirates], and [medials] form [the voiceless consonants.]

**10.** [Opposed to nature, the consonants and vowels] are combined [with one another, and] they are distinct from one another.

**11.** They are attached at the beginning and attached at the end, and they form an ignorant taxonomy,

**12.** and the ensuing syllables are one or two, or three or [four], or five or six, or as many as seven, possessing a [single] sound.

**13.** These [possess] two [sounds], being grouped together with [the seventeen consonants.]

**14.** [Among] those already named, [some] are defective, and as though [they] possessed no being, or as though [they] were a reflection [of] being, [or] as though they divide the beneficial nature [from the harmful one] in the [medial position];

**15.** and you [will gather] the patterns that are similar to one another, the vowels [together with] the consonants.

**16.** The examples include:

BAGAD[A]ZATHA,

BEGED[E]ZETHE,

[BĒGĒDĒ]ZĒTHĒ,

[BIGIDIZITHI],

[BOGO]ZOTHO,

[BUGUDUZUTHU],

BŌGŌDŌ[THŌ],
[and] the remaining ones,

**17.** [and some include]:

BA[BEBĒBIBOBUBŌ],

**18.** but the remaining ones are dissimilar:

ABEBĒBI[B]OB,
so that you can [group] them together and be divided from the angels,

**19.** and there will be various effects.

sections.heading: 14. Letter Arithmetic
sections.body:
**1.** The primary good derives from the Triad,

**2.** and it [prolongs itself to what] needs [the One, which] restricted [it inside] a shape.

**3.** ‹The› Dyad as well as the Monad are dissimilar to everything, being instead primary existents.

**4.** The Dyad [forms] a separation [from the] Monad, [and it] pertains to the hypostasis, but the Tetrad obtained the [elements] and the Pentad obtained agreement, and the [Hexad] was self-completed.

**5.** The [Hebdomad] obtained beauty, [and the] Ogdoad [adjusted its components to harmony, and the Ennead is far more esteemed],

**6.** and the [Decad made manifest] the entirety of the place,

**7.** but the Hendecad and the [Dodecad] have traveled beyond, [into the limitless, and] it [is loftier than] the Hebdomad, [which is limited ...].

**2.** [The images] of being [are also this way], originating [from a union] of the letters in [a sacred merger] in agreement with an [apposition] by which they exist individually,

**3.** and ‹they› exist together with one [another] through generation or [by affinity],

**4.** [and] in agreement with [their own generation] they possess no [...] these [...].

**5.** [... they possess ...] one [...] telling the enigma,

**6.** because in the perceptible sensorial world exists the temple [that measures] seven hundred [cubits], and a river that [...] inside an eternity.

**7.** They [...] three [...] to the four [...] seals [...] clouds [and the] waters, and the [forms of the] wax images, and various emerald likenesses.

**8.** As for the remainder, I will [instruct you] concerning them.

**9.** Here is the generation of the names:

**10.** What [was not] generated [... from the] beginning [...].

**11.** [...] concerning [...] stand [...] but, [... thr]ice, when [closed], when prolonged, when [brief].

sections.heading: 16. The Formation of Words
sections.body:

**3.** [... one] can [understand that] existent [entities] everywhere [are] continually [esteemed], [because they] abide with both the somatic and the non-somatic ones.

**4.** This is the speech concerning the hypostases, which one should [understand] in this way.

**5.** If [they do] not [speak] to one another, [how] can speech assist [those who] are troubled [with speech concerning what is] visible?

**6.** [Consequently], if it is understood, one will [utter] it, but some words are [dual, and others] are [individual, pertaining] to [being ...].

**7.** [...] and they [...] or those that [... in agreement with those that persist (continually)], or in agreement with [those that] exhibit temporality,

**8.** and [these] are either divided or unified with one another (as a group) or with themselves (individually), either the diphthongs or the simple [vowels], or all the [...] or [...] or [... exist] exactly like [... exist ...] the [consonants ...] they exist individually until they are divided and unified.

**9.** Now, some are able [to generate consonants one letter] at [a time ...] difference [...].

**11.** [They will be counted] once [or twice], and thrice [for] vowels, and twice [for] consonants, and once for the whole group, and one cannot know (beforehand how to count) [those that are] subject to change, [as is the case also with those that] are derived [from them], as well as [all those that come] after these,

**12.** and they are all [simultaneous names.]

**13.** [They] had been concealed, but they were enunciated openly.

**14.** They did not cease from being disclosed, nor did they cease giving names to the angels.

**15.** The vowels [are unified together with] the [consonants, either] outwardly [or] interiorly, through [...] they spoke [... instruct you ...] once more [in in this way were they counted] four times, and they were [engendered] thrice, and they became [twelvefold].
